anticancer.label: Anticancer
anticancer.description: Inhibits tumor cell proliferation and induces apoptosis in various cancer types.

immunomodulatory.label: Immunomodulatory
immunomodulatory.description: Activates and regulates immune cells including T cells, B cells, NK cells, and macrophages.

antioxidant.label: Antioxidant
antioxidant.description: Neutralizes free radicals, reduces oxidative stress, and protects cells from damage.

hepatoprotective.label: Hepatoprotective
hepatoprotective.description: Protects the liver against oxidative damage, inflammation, and hepatic steatosis.

anti-fatigue.label: Anti-fatigue
anti-fatigue.description: Reduces physical and mental fatigue, especially in chemotherapy contexts.

anti-inflammatory.label: Anti-inflammatory
anti-inflammatory.description: Inhibits pro-inflammatory cytokines like TNF-α and IL-6 via cellular signaling pathways.

neuroprotective.label: Neuroprotective
neuroprotective.description: Protects the brain against neurodegenerative damage and improves cognitive function.

cardiovascular.label: Cardiovascular
cardiovascular.description: Improves endothelial function, reduces blood pressure, and protects against heart disease.

anticancer-colon.label: Anticancer (Colon)
anticancer-colon.description: Potentiates apoptosis of colon cancer cells through p53-dependent pathways.

metabolic.label: Metabolic Health
metabolic.description: Improves glycemic control, insulin sensitivity, and lipid profiles.

anti-obesity.label: Anti-obesity
anti-obesity.description: Suppresses adipocyte differentiation and reduces body fat accumulation.

prebiotic.label: Prebiotic
prebiotic.description: Enriches beneficial gut microbiota, especially Bifidobacterium and Lactobacillus.

weight-loss.label: Weight Management
weight-loss.description: Reduces total body fat and prevents weight gain in experimental models.

glucose-control.label: Glycemic Control
glucose-control.description: Reduces fasting glucose, HbA1c, and improves insulin sensitivity.

lipid-management.label: Lipid Management
lipid-management.description: Reduces total cholesterol, triglycerides, and LDL, while increasing HDL.

gut-health.label: Gastrointestinal Health
gut-health.description: Improves bowel function, protects intestinal mucosa, and produces short-chain fatty acids.

barrier-integrity.label: Intestinal Barrier Integrity
barrier-integrity.description: Strengthens mucosa, increases mucus production, and protects colonic epithelial architecture.

metabolic-syndrome.label: Metabolic Syndrome
metabolic-syndrome.description: Helps reduce insulin resistance, adiposity, steatosis, and other metabolic syndrome markers.

endothelial-function.label: Endothelial Function
endothelial-function.description: Improves endothelium-dependent vasodilation and vascular lining health.

cardioprotective.label: Cardioprotective
cardioprotective.description: Reduces cardiovascular risk and supports vascular, thrombotic, and metabolic heart function.

blood-pressure.label: Blood Pressure
blood-pressure.description: Significantly reduces systolic and diastolic blood pressure in adults with hypertension.

stroke-prevention.label: Stroke Prevention
stroke-prevention.description: Reduces stroke risk by 4% per additional cup of daily consumption.

cholesterol-glucose.label: Cholesterol & Glucose Control
cholesterol-glucose.description: Supports healthier lipid and glycemic profiles through bioactive polyphenols and catechins.

gut-microbiota.label: Gut Microbiota
gut-microbiota.description: Modulates the intestinal microbial community and favors metabolites linked to systemic health.

antimicrobial.label: Antimicrobial
antimicrobial.description: Inhibits growth of pathogenic bacteria including Staphylococcus, E. coli, and resistant ESKAPE pathogens.

antidiabetic.label: Antidiabetic
antidiabetic.description: Improves glucose metabolism and insulin function with effects comparable to metformin.

wound-healing.label: Wound Healing
wound-healing.description: Promotes cell migration and tissue repair.
